Name: Bigger Containers (Bigger junimo chests and fridges)
Author: SummerFleur
Description:
Do you think your fridges and Junimo chests too small to hold your items? This mod makes them bigger! You can select which container types (Fridge, Mini Fridge, Junimo Chests) should have this feature enabled, for Junimo chests, you can also customize its capacity.

This mod is inspired by Entoarox's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21678]Bigger Fridges[/url], I write this mod for better compatibility with my another mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32558]Convenient Chests[/url], and added more detailed customizable choices. The mod [i]convenient chest [/i]is also a useful mod, so why don't you come and have a try? 😉

This mod supports i18n, and contributions are welcome! You can commit your translation on [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/tree/master/BiggerContainers#translating-the-mods]Github[/url]. English is not my mother tongue, so for native English users, if you want to improve the current English translation, you can also come and help!

[b][size=4]Install[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[b][size=4]Found a bug?[/size][/b]

Please submit bugs on the [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/issues]Github issue tracker[/url]﻿, please avoid leave comments at nexus because I don't check it often.

[b][size=4]Thanks to...[/size][/b]

[list]

[*][url=https://github.com/Entoarox]Entoarox[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21678]Bigger Fridges[/url]

你是否觉得冰箱和祝尼魔箱太小了不够用？这个模组将帮助你解决这个问题！本模组能够能够扩大冰箱、迷你冰箱和祝尼魔箱的容量。且可以自定义是否要在冰箱、迷你冰箱和祝尼魔箱上启用该功能。对于祝尼魔箱，还可以自定义它的容量。

本模组借鉴了 Entoarox 的 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21678]Bigger Fridges[/url] 模组，开发本模组的目的主要是为了更好的与我的另一个模组 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32558]Convenient Chests[/url] 兼容。当然，本模组也提供了更细致的可配置选项。[i]Convenient chest [/i] 同样也是一个非常实用的模组，所以何不来试试呢？😉
